objectives_fil: Gumawa ng maikling ulat para sa midwife na may concern, pinagmulan at hindi pa tiyak na detalye, hinihinging aksyon at ligtas na paraan ng pagpapadala.
objectives_en: Prepare a short handoff for the midwife containing the concern, sources and uncertainty, requested action and a secure delivery method.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ang pagtatala at paglalahad ng impormasyon ay dapat malinaw, may susunod na hakbang at para lamang sa tamang tatanggap.
sections.takeaway_en: Recording and presenting information requires clarity, a next step and the appropriate recipient.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ang parehong concern ay maaaring ilahad nang magkaiba ayon sa layunin at tamang tatanggap.
sections.takeaway_en: The same concern can be presented differently for the purpose and appropriate recipient.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ang paglalahad sa pulong ay humihingi ng konkretong desisyon habang pinangangalagaan ang pribadong kuwento.
sections.takeaway_en: A meeting presentation asks for a concrete decision while protecting private stories.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ang ulat ay sapat para makakilos ang tamang tao, habang protektado ang pribadong detalye.
sections.takeaway_en: A handoff gives the right person enough to act while protecting private details.

check.prompt_fil: Humihingi ang barangay meeting ng paliwanag sa missed visits. Ano ang ibabahagi?
check.prompt_en: A barangay meeting asks about missed visits. What should be shared?

options.fil: Ang pinagsamang childcare barrier at tanong tungkol sa iskedyul.
options.en: The aggregated childcare barrier and a question about scheduling.

options.fil: Mga larawan ng household forms para kumpleto.
options.en: Photos of household forms for completeness.

options.fil: Pangalan ng bawat pamilya at opinyon ng kapitbahay.
options.en: Each family’s name and the neighbor’s opinion.

check.feedback_fil: Ang unang sagot ay angkop sa pagpaplano. Ang forms at pangalan ay naglalantad ng hindi kailangang personal na detalye; ang opinyon ay hindi ebidensya ng dahilan. Ang indibidwal na follow-up ay sa tamang health team member.
check.feedback_en: The first response fits planning. Forms and names expose unnecessary personal details; an opinion is not evidence of the cause. Individual follow-up goes to the appropriate health team member.
